title: Step 64-E customer orders, detail, timeline, invoice and authoritative actions
description: HIGH-risk Step 64-E. Productionize SF-E-04 /account/orders and SF-E-05 /account/orders/:order-number from canonical generated contracts. Use cursor pagination, customer-owned order detail, normalized timeline, invoice truth and only backend-authorized order cancellation. Repair the discovered order timeline runtime/OpenAPI shape mismatch without changing database/business eligibility. Do not invent filters, payment authority, return/warranty eligibility, backend rules or Step 64-F+ functionality.

dependencies.evidence: PR #322 merged through protected workflow_dispatch 37464041417; exact-SHA postmerge verification job 112275367104 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6016630544.

acceptance_criteria.description: SF-E-04 /account/orders uses the canonical generated GET /customer/orders contract, fixed bounded page size and cursor pagination. It does not invent backend filters, totals or previous-page authority.
SF-E-05 /account/orders/:order-number loads only customer-owned detail from GET /customer/orders/{order_number}; ownership-denied/not-found behavior leaks no record existence or content.

Order timeline runtime data is normalized to the canonical OrderTimelineResponse contract with from_status/to_status/reason/created_at before Storefront consumption; no OpenAPI or business-rule mutation is introduced.

Invoice presentation consumes GET /customer/orders/{order_number}/invoice and renders only authoritative integer-Toman values from the embedded OrderResponse. No fabricated PDF/file download or wallet behavior is added.
Cancel control is shown only when authoritative OrderResponse.allowed_actions includes cancel_order, and the server re-fetches current order state before POST /customer/orders/{order_number}/cancel.
Customer cancel mutation uses required idempotency, bounded reason_code/note, and treats 401/403/404/409/422/unknown outcomes fail-closed without manufacturing success.
Session credentials remain server-only through CustomerSessionBridge; order/payment/customer identifiers never become browser auth authority, analytics secrets or raw diagnostic payload.

Persian RTL order list/detail/invoice/timeline UI has stable bidi order references, integer-Toman formatting, semantic loading/empty/error/terminal states, 44px targets, visible focus and responsive reflow.
No DB migration, dependency, OpenAPI/generated contract, Product Design, Current-State, payment, Returns/Warranty or Step 64-F+ mutation is introduced.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 64-E is HIGH risk because it presents customer-owned order financial state and can invoke order cancellation. Final Project Owner HUMAN approval must bind to the frozen exact head/artifact after technical/security gates are green. Direct-main/raw merge prohibited.
